sources.name: OCAC / HuayuWorld — Let's Learn Mandarin (For Children)
purpose: verify cited title and course metadata

license.name: No general public redistribution license identified for app ingestion
license.scope: The site describes downloadable textbooks, text, images, audio, and teaching materials; this record does not infer a public-repository or commercial license.

constraints: Reference/citation only until the applicable permission is documented.
Do not ingest or redistribute textbook text, vocabulary lists, questions, images, audio, or close rewrites.
Do not treat teacher access or website availability as a license for public or commercial reuse.

sources.name: Taiwan Benchmarks for the Chinese Language (TBCL)
sources.owner: National Academy for Educational Research (NAER), Taiwan

license.name: No reuse license recorded for bulk lists in this registry
license.scope: Public framework descriptions and level references only; full character, vocabulary, and grammar tables are not mirrored.

constraints: Use for reference, validation, and evidence citation only.
Do not bulk mirror the 14,425-word or 496-grammar-point datasets or other source tables.
A specific item may be ingested only after its reuse terms are verified and recorded.
sources.notes: Official site describes level descriptors and lists; absence of a visible license statement is not treated as permission.

sources.name: TOCFL / Children's Mandarin Competency Certification (CCCC)
sources.owner: Steering Committee for the Test Of Proficiency-Huayu (SC-TOP)

license.name: CCCC question bank is marked for learning use and not commercial use; no public-repository dataset license recorded
license.scope: The official CCCC page's question-bank use notice; individual TOCFL resources may have separate conditions.

constraints: Reference level descriptions and cite evidence only unless item-specific permissions say otherwise.
Do not mirror question banks, test text, answer keys, audio, or images.
The CCCC question bank page states learning use only and prohibits commercial use.
sources.notes: TOCFL and CCCC are grouped for reference tracking; each future resource must be registered at item/source granularity before ingestion.

sources.name: CC-CEDICT
sources.owner: CC-CEDICT contributors; distribution page maintained by MDBG

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)
license.scope: CC-CEDICT dataset as identified on its official download page.

constraints: Preserve CC BY-SA attribution and license notices.
Distribute covered adaptations/database derivatives under compatible share-alike terms.
Record source/version and changes; do not mark derived data as MIT.
Check each release/version for additional source conditions.
sources.notes: GREEN means the named license is usable subject to its conditions; it is not a blanket commercial clearance for unrelated data.

sources.name: Tatoeba sentence corpus and contributed audio

license.name: Sentence text defaults to CC BY 2.0 FR; CC0 is available for eligible original sentences; audio license is contributor-specific
license.scope: License must be resolved per sentence and separately per audio contributor/item.

constraints: Store the item ID, contributor, source license, attribution, and changes for every imported sentence.
Never infer a sentence license from another item or from the corpus default when item metadata differs.
Audio requires separate per-contributor license verification; do not assume text and audio terms match.
Do not bulk import until the selected items and terms are verified.
sources.notes: Registry legalStatus is GREEN_WITH_CONDITIONS encoded as GREEN plus explicit constraints, per the project enum.

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice zh-TW / Mozilla Data Collective
sources.owner: Mozilla Foundation and Common Voice contributors

license.name: CC0 1.0; dataset access and distribution are subject to Mozilla Data Collective terms
license.scope: Common Voice datasets and access channel, subject to current terms and any dataset-specific notice.

constraints: TongXuan project policy: do not post, distribute, or mirror any dataset, in whole or in part, on another platform or service.
Access datasets through Mozilla Data Collective and follow its current access terms.
Do not commit downloaded audio or dataset rows to this public repository.
sources.notes: CC0 dataset licensing is distinct from Mozilla Data Collective access terms. Mozilla asks users not to repost, distribute, or mirror datasets; this project follows that request as a conservative repository policy.

sources.name: TongXuan original-authored content
sources.owner: TongXuan and contributors who have granted the project rights

license.name: Project-owned content terms must be assigned per item; root MIT is not assumed to cover content
license.scope: Only content with documented project ownership or contributor grant; AI output alone is not evidence of ownership or curriculum approval.

constraints: Record author, creation date, and rights grant for every published item.
AI/Codex proposals do not become official targets until human/Architect approval.
Original authorship does not substitute for level, prerequisite, difficulty, or learner-evidence rationale.
sources.notes: GREEN is conditional on item-level authorship/rights evidence and the separate curriculum approval gate.
